Medical_Claims_Select.defaultValue:
'SELECT ResultSet
FROM (
        SELECT 1 AS SortOrder,'claim_id,claim_line_id,claim type,member_id,servicing_provider_tin,servicing_provider_tin_name,servicing_provider_npi,servicing_provider_npi_name,date_from,date_to,admission_date,discharge_date,place_of_service,bill_type,drg,inpatient_days,diag_id,diag_code_1,diag_code_2,diag_code_3,diag_code_4,diag_code_5,diag_code_6,diag_code_7,adj_code,proc_code,rev_code,proc_mod,paid_amount,paid_date' AS ResultSet

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS SortOrder, CONCAT( [claim_id],',',[claim_line_id],',', [claim type],',', [member_id]    ,',', [servicing_provider_tin],',', [servicing_provider_tin_name],',', [servicing_provider_npi],',', [servicing_provider_npi_name],',', [date_from],',', [date_to],',', [admission_date],',', [discharge_date],',', [place_of_service],',', [bill_type],',', [drg],',', [inpatient_days],',', [diag_id],',', [diag_code_1],',', [diag_code_2],',', [diag_code_3],',', [diag_code_4],',', [diag_code_5],',', [diag_code_6],',', [diag_code_7],',', [adj_code],',', [proc_code],',', [rev_code],',', [proc_mod],',',[paid_amount],',', [paid_date]) AS ResultSet
    FROM  EXTRACT.LA_UPWARDHEALTH_MEDICALCLAIMS 
) AS CombinedResults
ORDER BY SortOrder, ResultSet;'

Member_Elig_Select.defaultValue:
'SELECT ResultSet
FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS SortOrder, 'member_id,member_first_name,member_middle_initial,member_last_name,member_gender,member_dob,member_address1,member_address2,member_city,member_county,member_state,member_zip,member_home_phone,member_mobile_phone,member_alternate_phone,primary_language,line_of_business,plan_desc,raf,medicare_Rev,effective_date,term_date,pcp_npi,pcp_name,pcp_tin,pcp_tin_name,pcp_address1,pcp_address2,pcp_city,pcp_state,pcp_zip,cob_ind' AS ResultSet
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS SortOrder, CONCAT(
        member_id, ',', member_first_name, ',', member_middle_initial, ',', member_last_name, ',', member_gender, ',', member_dob, ',', member_address1, ',', member_address2, ',', member_city, ',', member_county, ',', member_state, ',', member_zip, ',', member_home_phone, ',', member_mobile_phone, ',', member_alternate_phone, ',', primary_language, ',', line_of_business, ',', plan_desc, ',', raf, ',', medicare_Rev, ',', effective_date, ',', term_date, ',', pcp_npi, ',', pcp_name, ',', pcp_tin, ',', pcp_tin_name, ',', pcp_address1, ',', pcp_address2, ',', pcp_city, ',', pcp_state, ',', pcp_zip, ',', cob_ind
    ) AS ResultSet
    FROM EXTRACT.LA_UPWARDHEALTH_MEMELIG(NOLOCK)
) AS CombinedResults
ORDER BY SortOrder, ResultSet;'
